description: UNDERSTANDING — Find venture-capital firms by name, thesis tags, or category. Each carries a network-matched, rated portfolio graph. Sort by portfolio_on_network (default), portfolio_total, portfolio_rating, or name. Understanding plan. Priced B1 (single-entity synthesis) — $0.01 per call under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. See apis://prices.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use with `limit` to walk a long list.

sort.description: Order: portfolio_on_network, portfolio_total, portfolio_rating or name.

tags.description: Tag slugs. On PROVIDERS this is identity — what the company says it does, from its own apis.yml. A resource or operation term (webhook, saml, order, oai-pmh) will correctly match no provider; use find_apis?tags= for those, or find_providers?api_tags= to reach companies whose APIs merely touch it.

name: find_vcs
